name: aether
description: Aether mode for Claude Code: the Lead on Sonnet holds the conversation, the Designer on Opus writes specs and plans, and a parallel swarm of Haiku, Sonnet and Opus implementers builds them, each attempt supervised and every merge made one at a time. Lanes run its calls on other coding plans, such as agy, while their quota lasts. The Lead decides as the owner's delegate and, with the owner's permission, works for hours and ends with a brief.

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Run Aether's calls on agy while its quota lasts. Off by default: agy runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions and spends another plan's quota. Linux only.
